summary_1line: With Arjuna away performing ascetic penance, the remaining Pandavas and Draupadi mourn his absence in the Kamyaka forest and recall his heroic deeds.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandavas and Draupadi sit sorrowfully in the Kamyaka forest, the empty grass bed of Arjuna beside them under tall blossoming trees.
Draupadi gazes through the flowering forest with tears, lamenting Arjuna while the brothers listen in grief.
